newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold volume rises on lower world prices.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold volume rises on lower world prices.

text.p: Volume rose on the Istanbul gold exchange on Monday with dealers moving to close positions as gold's price on international markets continued to fall.

Volume stood at 1,035 kilos, up from 708 kilos on Friday. Gold closed lower in line with world trends to $360.20 an ounce against Friday's $364.50, and 1,265,500 lira per gram, versus the 1,276,000 level at Friday's close.
Gold's price fall in dollar terms was big enough to drag down the lira price, despite the weaker lira. The lira closed at 109,480 lira to the dollar against Friday's 108,350.
There was 915 kilos of trade in the morning session and 120 kilos in the afternoon when no lira term trade took place, 86.0 percent of trade was conducted in lira terms.
